brief.goal: Set up the Electron desktop application shell with embedded SQLite database, enforcing contextBridge/IPC security rules and basic window management.
brief.constraints: Electron + Node.js stack (PRD PDR-001); SQLite with WAL mode for local data storage; contextBridge and IPC handler security rules (team security directives); Phase 1 of the Alpha milestone roadmap; Must pass Electron security best practices (no node integration in renderer)
brief.non_goals: No email connectors (Gmail/M365); No AI triage engine; No n8n Docker sidecar; No LAN dashboard server
success_criteria: Electron app launches and displays a dashboard UI
SQLite database initialized on first run with WAL mode
contextBridge and IPC handler security rules enforced
Basic window management (minimize, maximize, close) works
